protocol.rating_rule: Common SFT-1015 anchor star comparison, NOT all pairs. Original iter17-vs-SFT 33 fixtures plus 3 API-vs-SFT cohorts of 33 = 132. Latency remains part of real-time gameplay.
protocol.paired_rule: Seed42; identical current canonical engine, goal, actual initial observations and decision budget; reuse nine exact-bound original SFT anchor episodes. API server latency and local SFT latency are reported, not removed from real-time clock.
protocol.board_rule: same seeded opening, two legs with swapped seats; actual terminal winner
protocol.execution_order: source cohort ordinal: original33 first, new99 next; Elo recomputed from preserved actual outcomes
protocol.direct_rule: Current native direct games; each challenger faces exact SFT-1015 anchor with both seats; no challenger-vs-challenger fixtures
